devices.title: Time clocks
devices.subtitle: Registry of the time clocks found in device export files (phase 1: file import only).
devices.importHint: Punch files are uploaded in Data import (types ATT_PUNCH_EXCEL, ATT_PUNCH_ZKTECO, ATT_PUNCH_HIKVISION).

mappings.title: Employee enrolment IDs
mappings.subtitle: Map each time-clock enrolment ID to an employee for a validity period. Punches without a matching ID are quarantined.
mappings.endHelp: The ID no longer applies from this date (the end date is exclusive).
mappings.tenantWideOnly: Only IDs valid on every clock

quarantine.title: Unmatched punches
quarantine.subtitle: Punches that match no time clock or employee enrolment ID. Add the clock or ID and re-match, or ignore them with a reason.
quarantine.rematchHelp: Matches every unresolved punch in the range (and the selected clock / enrolment ID) again with the current clocks and IDs.
quarantine.rematchDone: Examined {examined, number}: matched {matched, number}, {still, number} still unmatched.
quarantine.ignoreHelp: The punches stay stored as evidence but are not used for timesheets.
quarantine.rangeTooLong: The range is at most {days, number} days.

errors.device-code-taken: The clock code is already used.
errors.terminal-code-taken: The terminal code is already used by another clock.
errors.invalid-device-code: The clock code takes upper-case letters, digits, '-' and '_' (at most 40).
errors.device-not-in-scope: You have no access to this time clock.
errors.device-of-other-legal-entity: The time clock belongs to another legal entity.
errors.enrolment-mapping-overlap: The enrolment ID is already mapped to another employee in this period.
errors.range-too-long: The date range is too long.
errors.legal-entity-not-in-scope: You have no access to this legal entity.
